hook.name: RobinhoodV4SelectableFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a fixed 1.5% base fee plus a launch-time configurable creator fee (0–10%) on swaps. Fees are collected in the non-launch-token currency and minted as ERC6909 claims to the creator's designated recipient; pool creation and liquidity are restricted to the factory and position manager.
